title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Strictly Implementing the Criminal Procedure Law and Effectively Correcting and Preventing Extended Detention
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security

Notice on Strictly Implementing the Criminal Procedure Law and Effectively Preventing and Correcting Extended Detention

Fa [2003] No. 163

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, the Military Procuratorate, and the Security Department of the General Political Department:

At present, the phenomenon of extended detention has not been effectively curbed in many parts of the country. Situations such as "clearing after extension," "clearing while extending," and "detaining without adjudication" continue to occur frequently, arousing strong public concern. People's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs at all levels must adhere to the guidance of the important thought of "Three Represents," uphold the work requirement of justice for the people, strictly implement the relevant provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law, earnestly improve the quality and efficiency of handling criminal cases, maintain the fair image of the people's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs, resolutely correct and prevent the phenomenon of extended detention, and respect and protect the lawful rights and interests of criminal suspects and defendants. The relevant issues are hereby notified as follows:

1. Further correct the ideology of law enforcement, and firmly establish the criminal litigation concept of attaching equal importance to substantive law and procedural law, and attaching equal importance to combating crime and protecting human rights. The socialist judicial system must ensure the realization of fairness and justice throughout society. When people's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs conduct criminal proceedings according to law, they must not only punish crimes and maintain social stability, but also respect and protect human rights. Respecting and protecting the lawful rights and interests of criminal suspects and defendants is the organic unity of punishing crimes according to law and protecting human rights according to law. No person shall be determined guilty before a lawful judgment by a people's court. In all stages of investigation, prosecution, and trial, proceedings must always be conducted according to law, the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law regarding the detention period of criminal suspects and defendants must be strictly observed, and the erroneous concept of emphasizing substance over procedure and emphasizing combat over protection must be resolutely overcome to avoid the occurrence of violations of the lawful rights and interests of criminal suspects and defendants due to extended detention.

2. Strictly apply the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law concerning the detention period for criminal suspects and defendants, and strictly prohibit arbitrary extension of the detention period. Where a criminal suspect or defendant is detained, the people's court, people's procuratorate, and public security organ shall promptly handle the procedures for transferring custody at different stages of criminal proceedings. During the investigation stage, the provisions on the detention period after arrest or detention must be strictly observed; if an extension of the detention period is needed after the arrest of a criminal suspect, it must meet the circumstances specified in Article 124, Article 126, or Article 127 of the Criminal Procedure Law, and must be approved or decided by the people's procuratorate at the next higher level or the people's procuratorate of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government. During the stage of reviewing arrests and the stage of reviewing prosecutions, the people's procuratorate shall make a decision within the statutory time limit. During the trial stage, the people's court must strictly observe the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law on the trial period; if an extension of the trial period by one month is needed, it must fall under one of the circumstances specified in Article 126 of the Criminal Procedure Law, and must be approved or decided by the high people's court of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government.

If the circumstances do not meet the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law on recalculating the detention period for criminal suspects or defendants, the detention period shall not be recalculated. It is strictly prohibited to abuse methods such as returning for supplementary investigation, withdrawing prosecution, or changing jurisdiction to indirectly extend the detention of criminal suspects or defendants.

3. Accurately apply the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law on release on bail pending trial and residential surveillance. When a people's court, people's procuratorate, or public security organ adopts compulsory measures against a criminal suspect or defendant, if the conditions for release on bail pending trial or residential surveillance are met, such measures shall be adopted according to law. For criminal suspects or defendants already detained, they must be immediately released upon expiration of their statutory detention period; if investigation, prosecution, or trial activities have not yet been completed and further verification or trial is needed, the compulsory measures shall be changed to release on bail pending trial or residential surveillance according to law, giving full play to the role of these two compulsory measures, so as to achieve the unity of pursuing criminal responsibility and protecting the lawful rights and interests of criminal suspects and defendants.

4. Adhere to handling cases according to law, correctly apply the law, prosecute according to law for guilt, and resolutely release the innocent. In the process of criminal proceedings, the people's court, people's procuratorate, and public security organ shall divide responsibilities, cooperate with each other, exercise mutual checks and balances, and proceed according to law to avoid the occurrence of extended detention. At each stage of investigation, prosecution, and trial, whenever it is found that a criminal suspect or defendant should not or does not need to bear criminal responsibility, the case shall be dismissed according to law, or a decision not to prosecute shall be made, or the trial shall be terminated, or a verdict of not guilty shall be pronounced. The public security organs and people's procuratorates must strictly implement the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law on the conditions for detention and arrest; if the conditions are not met, detention shall not be carried out, a request for approval of arrest shall not be submitted, or a decision not to approve arrest shall be made. For cases that have undergone two supplementary investigations or where the people's procuratorate recommends supplementary investigation during the trial stage and the people's court decides to postpone the trial, the people's procuratorate shall no longer return the case to the public security organ; for cases that, after two supplementary investigations, still have insufficient evidence and do not meet the conditions for prosecution, a decision not to prosecute shall be made according to law. Public security organs shall strengthen the management of detention centers according to law and promptly notify the case-handling authorities of any instances of extended detention. For cases prosecuted by the people's procuratorate, after trial, if the people's court finds that the evidence is insufficient and the defendant cannot be found guilty, it shall according to law pronounce a verdict of not guilty due to insufficient evidence and failure to establish the alleged crime. For cases with unclear facts or insufficient evidence, the court of second instance, after trial, may only once rule to quash the original judgment and remand the case to the original trial court for retrial; for cases where, after investigation, only part of the criminal facts are clear and the evidence is sufficient, only that part of the crime shall be determined and adjudicated; for cases where, after investigation, the facts remain unclear or the evidence is insufficient, a verdict of not guilty shall be pronounced according to law due to insufficient evidence and failure to establish the alleged crime, and there shall be no delay or failure to render judgment.

5. Strictly implement the accountability system for extended detention. Extended detention infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of criminal suspects and defendants and undermines judicial fairness. This must be seriously investigated and dealt with, and leniency shall not be tolerated. After the issuance of this notice, if any person causes extended detention of a criminal suspect or defendant in violation of the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law and this notice, the directly responsible supervisor and other directly responsible personnel shall be subject to administrative or disciplinary sanctions by their unit or the superior competent authority according to relevant provisions; if the extended detention caused to a criminal suspect or defendant is serious in circumstances, the directly responsible supervisor and other directly responsible personnel shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of dereliction of duty or the crime of abuse of authority in accordance with Article 397 of the Criminal Law of the PRC.

6. For major, difficult, or complex cases, cases involving foreign elements, new types of cases, and cases involving national security that raise issues concerning the application of law, the matter shall be promptly reported to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for legislative interpretation or to the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate for judicial interpretation.

The implementation of this notice shall be reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security.

November 12, 2003
